web.named_query: ("Andrew Ferguson" OR "Mark Meador") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In September 2024, while an FTC commissioner, Ferguson described generative AI's economic and social utility as still being discovered and favored enforcing existing laws rather than imposing comprehensive regulation at that stage. In May and September 2025, Ferguson emphasized AI's potential for economic growth, worker productivity, and broadly shared benefits. He also called for intervention when AI is abused to injure consumers or workers and described enforcement against misleading claims about AI capabilities.
